copy.headline: Pons enters Proofline coverage with Elevated risk
copy.summary: Proofline completed its first full review of Pons. The product is live and its owner is an identifiable 2-of-3 Safe, but the deployed system has no timelock and no closed audit matched to the deployed code.
why_it_matters: Owner actions can take effect without a documented delay.
The project's own documentation describes the system as unaudited.
copy.watch_next: A deployed-code audit, timelock, clearer signer policy, or a source-level bound on owner setters would materially improve the assessment.
